mapper.select: SELECT answer_no , question_no , answer_type , answer_content , ans_mark_no FROM survey_answers ORDER BY answer_no

SELECT a.answer_no AS "answerNo" , COUNT(response_no) AS "responseCnt" , SUM(CASE WHEN p.account_type='E501' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "respStuCnt" , SUM(CASE WHEN p.account_type='E502' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "respParCnt" , a.answer_content AS "answerContent" FROM survey_answers a LEFT OUTER JOIN response_answers r ON (a.answer_no = r.answer_no) LEFT OUTER JOIN survey_people p ON (r.surv_man_no = p.surv_man_no) WHERE question_no = #{questionNo} GROUP BY a.answer_no, a.answer_content ORDER BY a.answer_no
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM survey_answers WHERE question_no IN(SELECT question_no FROM survey_question WHERE surv_no = #{survNo})
